═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                          WILLIAM YIJIANG LI
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Hi! I am William Yijiang Li, a 2nd-year PhD student in Machine Learning and Data Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering at [UC San Diego](https://ucsd.edu/), supported by the Jacobs Fellowship.

My research focuses on enabling **efficient** (label- [ICCV 23](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/ICCV2023/papers/Li_Diverse_Cotraining_Makes_Strong_Semi-Supervised_Segmentor_ICCV_2023_paper.pdf), [CVPR 23](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2023/papers/Wang_Consistent-Teacher_Towards_Reducing_Inconsistent_Pseudo-Targets_in_Semi-Supervised_Object_Detection_CVPR_2023_paper.pdf); sample- efficiency [AAAI 25](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/32978), [ICCV 25](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.18531); and synthetic data [ICML 26](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.10388)) and **robust** learning ([ICCV 23](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/ICCV2023/papers/Huang_Multi-Metrics_Adaptively_Identifies_Backdoors_in_Federated_Learning_ICCV_2023_paper.pdf), [NAACL 25](https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-naacl.172.pdf), [AAAI 25](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2403.10045), [ICML 25](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.12258)) of artificial general intelligence in **multi-modal** ([ICLR 25](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.02155), [ICCV 25](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.16156), [S²VOPD](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.14144v1)), **interactive** ([ICLR 26](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2026/file/372593bd318ad8b34b3a8da77e20272b-Paper-Conference.pdf)) and **3D embodied** ([Think3D](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.13029)) environments. To this end, a few questions drive my current work:
1. Understanding the capabilities and limits of foundation models through evaluation, e.g., [core knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10855), [conflict resolving](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2505.18969), [physical reasoning](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.07109), agentic abilities ([SkillsBench](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.12670), [CocoaBench](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.11201)) and interactive ([CEDI](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.14499), [ACL 26](https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-acl.504.pdf)) settings.
2. Can language (semantic, abstract and compositional) be used to scaffold vision learning, e.g. as an anchor representation?
3. How to model our intrinsically 3D world, e.g., 3D-aware architectures for LLMs, 3D representation emergence from 2D supervision, [thinking in 3D](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.13029), etc.
4. Embodied AI ([Think3D](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.13029)), world model ([CreFlow](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.14274)) and embodiment theory; learning with indirect feedback; and interactive learning (learning and inferring simultaneously).

I am also broadly interested in the various applications of AI, including but not limited to agents ([dMAS](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.07461), [GenoMAS](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.21035)), AI4Sci ([GenoMAS](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.21035)) and AI4AI (RSI).

I earned my M.S.E. in Computer Science at [Johns Hopkins University](https://www.jhu.edu/) and my B.E. in Computer Science at South China University of Technology. I have had the privilege of working with Prof. [Alan Yuille](https://www.cs.jhu.edu/~ayuille/) as a research assistant in [CCVL](https://ccvl.jhu.edu/), and with Prof. [Haohan Wang](https://haohanwang.github.io/) at [DREAM Lab](https://dreamlabuiuc.github.io/), UIUC. I have spent time as a research intern at the [Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence](https://www.baai.ac.cn/en/) and [SenseTime Research](https://www.sensetime.com/en).

I co-founded [GrowAI](https://growing-ai-like-a-child.github.io/), a research organization and community aiming to promote the research of AI that can learn and grow like humans.
